# Website Health Check: Nord & DeMaio (now trading as NordLaw)

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**

- The firm's original domain, nord-demaio.com, no longer answers on HTTPS; plain HTTP serves a Chinese-language page for an industrial dehumidifier company whose title and description promote an online gambling brand.
- That domain's public registration record starts on 27 March 2025 under registrar Gname.com Pte. Ltd., years after the firm's last archived use (18 August 2018).
- The current site, nordlaw.legal, is live and the Google profile (NordLaw, Legal services, Metroplex, 190 NJ-18 Ste 201, (732) 214-0303) links to it.
- One directory still points to the old domain: the Lawyers.com profile for Nord & Demaio lists http://www.nord-demaio.com under Additional Links. Their current site also renders at a fixed 980 px width, cutting off the phone layout.

**What it means for customers**

A client who arrives through that directory profile sees dehumidifier pages and gambling text instead of the firm's site. Comparing the old name with the new one, they may also be unsure which site is genuinely the firm's.

**How to fix it**

1. Find out who holds the nord-demaio.com registrar account and whether renewal was missed (0.5-1 hour).
2. If it is not recoverable, remove it from the Lawyers.com/Martindale profile, email signatures, letterhead and cards (1-2 hours).
3. Confirm the Google profile still points at nordlaw.legal - it currently does (0.5 hour).
4. Protect nordlaw.legal: auto-renew, 2FA on the registrar and Wix accounts, a reminder before the 9 January 2027 expiry (1 hour).
5. Rebuild the site to fit phones, with one page per practice area (20-40 hours).

**After the fix**

The claimed Google profile carries 2 reviews at 3.0 while the site cites nearly 40 years of practice. A short review request at the end of each matter is the simplest next gain.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
